He discovers his strange resemblance to the prison warden Riad Manfalouti, who's injured in an accident after Lemby attempts to escape. A doctor performs a surgery and puts Riad's brain into Lemby's body.

Salem is a playboy known for his multi-womanizing. He has a good relationship with the manager of his father's company. Salem is so spoiled that he can get as much money as he wants and spend it on his girl friends. His father and his wife discover his playboy antics and the events escalate in a comic atmosphere.
A thriller about the businessman Adam who faces criminal charges until the police enlist him for a critical mission. Will he deliver, or show an unexpected hidden side?

The renowned psychologist Dr. Shukry Mokhtar dedicates his final lecture to answering the most important question ever asked: how does love start? He explains the seven stages of love via four different love stories, going through their ups and downs.

Sherif is a private bodyguard, he works for a woman who gets into a lot of trouble as he protects her from a terrorist group that attacks her.

He returns home and begins his struggle with his wife against Medhat to preserve her land.

After a tragic accident happens to Muhammad while he is traveling to Yemen, he is taken to the hospital, and he loses his memory, so he tries to reach anyone who will give him information about his family.

In the Bir Al Tay area, where residents depend on farming and a local well, Mahmoud and his wife, Umm Rabea, harvest their crops and try to sell them. Conflicts arise over control and theft of the well’s water, set against a backdrop of revenge and power struggles within this rural agricultural community.

Remy's father works in Paris, and the two of them reside in a French hamlet. Remy learns after a while that they are not his biological parents. His adoptive father decides to sell him to a mobile cart owner named Vitalis who performs shows with animals and goes through painful events until he meets his real mother.

The third season continues the story of Noura and Abdel Rahman’s family and children, as each episode explains an aspect of the relationship between the children and their parents and the mother and father’s hopes for tomorrow and the future of the children.

In the village of Konoha, where powerful ninja fighters roam, a troublesome young man Naruto wreaks havoc wherever he goes. After graduating from the ninja academy, he believes that he knows everything, especially when he meets the grandson of the Hokage , the ruler of the village. But what will happen when Naruto unleashes a rare power by stealing the ancient seal scroll?

p.t: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
p.d: The Cat in the Hat knows a lot about almost everything, and he teaches children many things through songs and games with the help of his friends, and he goes on exciting adventures with Sally and Nick.

Father Time decides to turn five executives into baby animals, in an attempt to fix all the environmental disasters that have occurred, but the difficulty lies in turning them back into humans, which requires searching for gemstones that can help them return to the human world.

Monkey D. Luffy ate a Devil Fruit when he was young that granted him rubber attributes. At the age of 17, he decides to go on a journey to sail the seas in search of the legendary treasure One Piece that Gol D. Roger mentioned before his execution. He is accompanied by a team of 8 people. What does fate have in store for them?

Rivalries over power and wealth escalate between two families in the hamlet of Abdul Jabbar, and conflicts flare up between them because of a marriage that takes place between two parties of the two families.
